name: Terminals, Depots & Fuel Supply
enginesVendoredAt: NextGen, sha-identical with engines 60ee266 (MD3-0, engines PR #221) through the lead's shared vendor commit b1f29251 ('chore(engines): vendor the downstream family (engines 60ee266) for the Commercial & Trading courses'). Not re-vendored by this wave.

plan.state: FOUNDATION: recon, structure, digest, eighteen graded fields, scaffold and task files. No lesson, bank, panel or migration.
plan.thesis: A terminal's stock, a cargo's cost and a litre's pump price are each a chain of measured inputs walked in a stated order, and the engine refuses or names every link nobody measured (an opening stock, a strapping entry, a coefficient, a rate) instead of assuming it, because a figure that cannot come out wrong proves nothing.

tiers.beginner: THE TANK AND THE DAY: strapping, free water, the VCF form, the reconciliation from an opening stock, the trend. Graded: six volumes in m3 at 0.01.
tiers.intermediate: THE RACK, THE TANK FARM AND THE LANE: Erlang C, pumpable stock tank by tank, throughput economics, the lane, the fleet, the station. Graded: a probability at 0.0001, a wait, a stock and days of cover at 0.01, a cost per litre at 0.0001, a truck count at 0.5.
tiers.advanced: THE CARGO AND THE PRICE: one cargo every way, the landed cost walk, insurance on CIF, the ocean loss, the pump price waterfall, the government share, the exchange rate that breaks a cap. Graded: two dollar figures and an exchange rate at 0.01, three naira-a-litre figures at 0.0001.

digest.note: No section is history. SECTION 23 states the held items and the MD3-0 rules in force in the present tense, each with a measured figure. No clock is read, so the digest carries no as-of date.

grading.grader: public.academy_submit_capstone reads expected, tol and the answer as numeric, so every graded field is a number the engine returns; verdicts, directions and refusals are taught and never graded.
grading.tolerance: One unit in the last place the prompt asks for (0.5 for the one whole number): the engine rounds CIF and the landed total to the cent and the landed and pump prices to four decimals, so a correct reading can sit half a unit from the stored value on each side. One derivation: CLASSES in supply_capstone.mjs; precision.json is written from it and passes gradeprecision.py 18 of 18.
grading.collisionRule: No graded value within its tolerance of the absolute value of any number token the digest prints (the go-live rule), and no two graded values within the looser of their tolerances.

findings.T1-page: TAUGHT as a demonstration (SECTION 7): an opening stock taken from today's dip balances every day. Suite origin/main still does it; the repair is on the unmerged Suite branch fix/md3-0-supply-apps (41a974862 re-vendor 60ee266, 9ea9c63ad opening stock input). Go-live depends on it.
findings.F-R1: rackQueue accepts loadMinutes 0 (60/0 = Infinity) and reports a perfect rack. Not taught, not graded, reported for repair or hold.
findings.F-R2: throughputEconomics reads a blank fee, cost, throughput or loss as 0 with no note; tankFarmCover with no daily throughput returns daysOfCover null but turnsPerYear 0. Not taught, not graded; SECTION 2's claim scoped to measured inputs.
findings.F-R3: the engines repo's own terminalDepot unit test types a coefficient row { k0: 594.5418, k1: 0, k2: 0 } that looks published; the course uses a synthetic row only.
findings.page: Suite page (origin/main and 9ea9c63ad): days of cover on receipts plus deliveries, a gain counted as a loss for emissions, one density for the whole terminal. Not taught as app behaviour; the page's cover route is a discriminate wrong route.
findings.oracle-coverage: The day ledger and the farm block live in the oracles' main(); oracle_check.py transcribes them and says so. Recommend exporting day_ledger() and farm_cover() from oracle_terminaldepot.py.
findings.clock: Neither engine reads a clock or a random number: source read, fake clock and fake random rebuilds byte-identical.

decisions: Every graded field is the engine's full-precision return, graded at one unit in the last place the prompt asks for (0.5 for the truck count).

Standard volumes are graded from a VCF typed off the depot's own tables (invented), because the oracle pins the ASTM D1250 form without validating it and no coefficient table is shipped; the computed VCF is taught on a SYNTHETIC row and never graded.
The ORON pump price starts from the landed cost per litre at four decimals, as the Fuel Pricing page passes landed.perLitreLocal, and the prompt says so.
Days of cover are graded on liftings (the engine's definition); the page's receipts-plus-deliveries figure is a discriminate wrong route.
The kit leakage sweep of the lessons is REFUSED at the foundation (placeholders carry no number); gate_leakage_digest.sh runs the same kit gate over the digest split by owning tier instead.
Manifests carry the three panel ids, so courseContent.test.js 'every panel referenced is registered' is red until the panel phase registers them.
The downstream module is NOT added to src/lib/academyModules.js; the lab agent adds it for all three courses.
